mapper.sql: a.act10_repr_account_id AS repr_account_id , a.act10_company_id AS company_id , a.act10_repr_account_cd AS repr_account_code , a.act10_repr_account_nm AS repr_account_name , a.act10_attribute_cd AS attribute_code , f_cdnm('AccountAttributeCode', a.act10_attribute_cd, a.act10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS attribute_name , a.act10_tgt_repr_account_cd AS tgt_repr_account_code , (SELECT act10_repr_account_nm FROM act10_repr_account WHERE act10_repr_account_cd = a.act10_tgt_repr_account_cd AND act10_company_id = a.act10_company_id) AS tgt_repr_account_name , a.act10_note AS note

INSERT INTO act10_repr_account (act10_repr_account_id, act10_company_id, act10_repr_account_cd, act10_repr_account_nm, act10_attribute_cd, act10_tgt_repr_account_cd, act10_note) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{companyId} , act10_repr_account_cd , act10_repr_account_nm , act10_attribute_cd , act10_tgt_repr_account_cd , act10_note FROM act10_repr_account WHERE act10_company_id = 0 AND act10_repr_account_cd = #{reprAccountCode}
